text_original: Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Reviewer (2026 SU7 Max test drive) calls the driving experience nearly flawless and finds no fault with handling or chassis. Reviewer highlights the 2200 MPa high-strength steel used in multiple body areas as a safety strength. Reviewer states the urban assisted-driving system completed a complex left turn at a congested intersection. Reviewer finds highway assisted driving very effective. Reviewer reports that light snow blocked the lidar and the system then refused to engage any assistance at all, including basic lane keeping and adaptive cruise. Reviewer wants lane keeping and adaptive cruise to remain available as a fallback when the lidar is blocked. Reviewer states that in Beijing rush hour the system could not merge, kept signalling while going straight, and the reviewer had to take over to complete a lane change. Reviewer praises Apple CarPlay support. Reviewer praises the IFTTT-style custom automations (e.g. climate, fragrance and music triggered by buckling up) that can be shared via codes. Reviewer finds no faults with the interior or design. Reviewer states the car offers exceptional value at its price point.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Author (three months of ownership, 75 kWh) praises the striking, coupe-like exterior. Author finds the minimalist cabin premium-feeling. Author praises the soft Nappa front seats with wide adjustment, heating, ventilation and massage. Author finds it odd that the rear seats have lumbar support but no recline. Author states rear legroom is generous thanks to the 3,060 mm wheelbase. Author states the trunk fits two large suitcases but the car has no frunk, no glovebox and no lift-back tailgate. Author states acceleration is very quick for a car of its size. Author states handling is not a strength: the car is a heavy, comfortable cruiser rather than a corner carver. Author states the factory tyres feel squirmy in the wet, even at low speed. Author finds the air-suspension ride comfortable and hopes OTA updates will refine it further. Author reports real-world range of about 230-250 miles with the 75 kWh pack, well below the claimed figure. Author states battery swapping is convenient, taking about five minutes. Author states the standard NOP assist handles lane keeping, adaptive cruise and on/off-ramp steering. Author praises the premium tech: OLED screens, head-up display and the NOMI assistant head on the dashboard. Author states the ET7 is not a value-for-money choice.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Reviewer (2024 007 Smart AWD) states the steering is precise with adequate feedback and the car feels European, inspiring confidence in fast corners. Reviewer states acceleration is very fast, recalling far rarer high-end sports cars. Reviewer states very little road noise reaches the cabin. Reviewer finds the AR head-up display a little too bright and needed time to get used to it. Reviewer states the infotainment runs smoothly with no lag. Reviewer states the driver's seat ventilation and massage aid comfort and back support. Reviewer notes the lowered rear seat position may make sitting upright in the back less comfortable. Reviewer states rear passengers get ample headroom and knee room. Reviewer states the boot is deep with a large opening. Reviewer states the frunk is small and mainly holds the charging cables. Reviewer states the interior feels luxurious. Reviewer states the glass roof does not let the cabin get hot. Reviewer states automatic parking was confused by nearby cars on the first attempt and only succeeded on the second. Reviewer states visibility is decent even though the car sits low.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Reviewer (dual-motor S9) states the air suspension with adaptive damping balances comfort and agility, with a plush ride in Comfort mode. Reviewer states the car stays stable on poor roads and sharp bends, with precise steering and an engaging Sport mode. Reviewer states power delivery is ample and smooth, with confident highway overtaking. Reviewer states wind and road noise are effectively insulated. Reviewer states Huawei ADS 3.0 navigates complex road conditions precisely in both urban and highway driving. Reviewer praises the HarmonyOS 4 cockpit and its tight integration with the Huawei device ecosystem. Reviewer praises the rear-seat entertainment options (Huawei tablet, optional projector screen). Reviewer states the seats and ambient features create a luxurious, relaxing cabin. Reviewer states the trunk and frunk offer adequate storage for daily and travel needs. Reviewer praises the clean, minimalist design and the long body's commanding road presence. Reviewer states the S9 offers performance, technology and luxury comparable to a Mercedes EQS at a significantly lower price.
